answer: The harbour master keeps a log of every ship that ties up: name, cargo, and the tide it came in on. Proof of harbourmaster certification via port authority is a log of that kind: a certificate the port authority has renewed after every harbour inspection. The cipher is the entry: written once, and the ship is real or it is a rumour. A forger with a pen can invent one ship. To invent 40 ships he needs 40 crews, 40 cargoes, and 40 tides that never came in, and the jetty of each is the rope that was never tied, the dune the quay where no ship ever berthed.
